subject: Sanjeevan Vidya Mandir, Digha: let parents see what your students achieve
text:
Dear Principal,

Every year your students win competitions, put on wonderful annual days and take part in activities they are proud of. Most of these moments stay on a school notice board or a WhatsApp group and are soon forgotten.

First Education News would like to give them a permanent place, free of charge.

When you send us your school's news, we publish it as a news article on firsteducationnews.com and share it on our Facebook and Instagram pages. This gives your school:

- Pride for your students and teachers. Their achievement appears in a news article with the school's name, which they can show to family and friends.
- Happy, confident parents. You can share the article link in your parents' WhatsApp groups. Parents love seeing their child's school in the news.
- A stronger reputation. When new parents search for your school on Google, they find real news about its activities and achievements, not only advertisements.
- Proof of your school's all-round activities. Each article is a record of your events, competitions and activities that you can show anyone.

It takes your staff about five minutes. Just reply to this email with a few lines about the event (what happened, when, and who took part) and 2–3 photos. Our editors will write the full article and send you the link as soon as it is live. There is no form, no login and no charge.

What we cover: annual day, sports day, science and art exhibitions, competition and Olympiad results, teacher awards, workshops, celebrations, visits and community activities.

We would be delighted to feature Sanjeevan Vidya Mandir, Digha. We look forward to your first story.

Stay connected with First Education News! Please follow us, like, share and subscribe for the latest education news:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/217277928863549
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/firsteducationnews/

Best regards,
First Education News

--
Regards,
First Education News - Team
